scope.goal: Track npm and pnpm conformance for browser guest runtime productization.

cases.notes: Guest runner classifies the command as version, and the async CLI module evaluator now runs the vendored npm entry through workspace CJS evaluation with dynamic import shims for the npm display path.

Guest runner classifies the command as version, and the async CLI module evaluator now runs the vendored pnpm entry through workspace CJS evaluation with Node-shape process/fs/os/stream/events/timers/zlib support.
Validates virtual store, workspace links, bin links, frozen lockfile invariants, and copy-fallback node_modules materialization from a native pnpm fixture.

cases.command: vendored CLI static require graph preflight and fixture CLI module evaluation
cases.notes: Walks vendored npm and pnpm entry module graphs, resolves simple computed path entries, expands npm install/ci/run/exec command dispatch, resolves npmPath package metadata probes, classifies Keyv adapter loading as optional for the default browser runtime store path, handles JSON modules, ignores string/comment false positives, rejects missing package modules, verifies there are no static unsupported builtin gaps, and counts only optional probes after product-scope graph expansion. Also evaluates npm-shaped CLI fixtures plus vendored npm/pnpm --version entries, vendored npm local file dependency install, and vendored pnpm local file dependency install from workspace modules through async cli-module-evaluation with BrowserProcess stdout/stderr/exit handling.

cases.productGap: Browser runtime can now run vendored npm CLI module evaluation for a local file dependency install and materialize package-lock plus symlinked node_modules. Registry tarball dependency installs, ci, run/exec, lifecycle, peer, and optional policy still need real CLI module evaluation coverage.
Browser runtime applies the frozen local-file install plan for ci. Full npm cli ci evaluation still needs the vendored CLI module evaluator; host Node remains only as the reference comparator.

Browser runtime now validates fixture build script, lifecycle marker script, bin exec, and interrupted install-plan recovery through script-runner-application. Full npm lifecycle process spawning, peer resolver execution, and optional package policy still need real CLI module evaluation.

Browser runtime can now run vendored pnpm CLI module evaluation for a local file dependency install and materialize symlinked node_modules package files, pnpm-lock.yaml, node_modules/.modules.yaml, and virtual-store lock.yaml, plus validate and materialize workspace-only frozen install layout with copy-fallback links. Registry dependency installs, run/exec, lifecycle, peer, and optional policy still need real CLI module evaluation coverage.

Browser runtime now validates fixture build script, lifecycle marker script, bin exec, and interrupted install-plan recovery through script-runner-application. Full pnpm lifecycle process spawning, peer resolver execution, and optional package policy still need real CLI module evaluation.

gate.reason: Version boot, vendored npm/pnpm --version async CLI module evaluation, vendored npm local file dependency install CLI module evaluation, vendored pnpm local file dependency install CLI module evaluation, local install layout, npm ci plan application, store plan, script-runner-application run/exec/lifecycle fixture, interrupted install-plan recovery, tarball cache paths, and product-scope static CLI graph classification pass or partially pass in browser guest runtime, but dependency install matrices and full npm/pnpm ci/run/exec CLI module evaluation still depend on host-node-test-helper as the reference comparator. Static graph classification now covers simple computed entries, JSON modules, npm install/ci/run/exec command dispatch, npm config metadata probes, pnpm Keyv adapter optional loading, child_process diagnostics, crypto hashing/random subset, dns, fs/promises/lstat/utimes/rm/readlink/rename/symlink/copyFile/link, http/https, http2 diagnostics, net/tls unsupported diagnostics, inline worker_threads support for CLI evaluator worker pools, process.pid/process.report/process.hrtime, legacy url.parse/format/resolve, and lightweight constants/querystring/readline/string_decoder/timers/v8/zlib builtins. Remaining blocker is moving real npm/pnpm install/ci/run/exec CLI evaluation off the host-node-test-helper before product support.
